input.command: cd D:\pal; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8082/api/v1/companies' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; "COMPANIES => HTTP $($r.StatusCode) $($r.Content.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(200,$r.Content.Length)))" } catch { $resp = $_.Exception.Response; if ($resp) { $sr = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($resp.GetResponseStream()); "COMPANIES => HTTP $([int]$resp.StatusCode) $($sr.ReadToEnd())" } else { "COMPANIES => ERR $($_.Exception.Message)" } }; echo "== tally status =="; try { $t = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8082/api/v1/tally/status' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 30; "TALLY => HTTP $($t.StatusCode) $($t.Content)" } catch { $resp2 = $_.Exception.Response; if ($resp2) { $sr2 = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($resp2.GetResponseStream()); "TALLY => HTTP $([int]$resp2.StatusCode) $($sr2.ReadToEnd())" } else { "TALLY => ERR $($_.Exception.Message)" } }
